headline: Public hearings on security deposit disputes at 99 Loomis Street, 19 South Willard Street, and 92 Intervale Avenue.
summary: The meeting will hear three security deposit disputes between tenants and landlords. The properties are at 99 Loomis Street, 19 South Willard Street, and 92 Intervale Avenue.
items: Security deposit hearing, 99 Loomis Street: tenants Nathan Schoenbrodt, Gustavo Botero, Nathan Smith, Timothy Smith, Finn Hummel, and Jack Dobbins; landlords Kristen Feifert Clark and Brian Clark
Security deposit hearing, 19 South Willard Street: tenant Kim Marcellino; landlord WHN Properties, LLC
Security deposit hearing, 92 Intervale Avenue: tenants Rehema Abdi and Jason Seiler
location: Front Conference Room, 645 Pine Street, Burlington, VT 05401
